# OutBids.auction

> OutBids.auction is a real-time, transparent digital visibility marketplace where creators, startups, developers, and brands bid for top broadcast ranking spots on a live attention billboard.

## Core Features
- **Real-Time Auction Leaderboard**: Live ranking powered by Supabase WebSockets. Rank #1 gets the hero spotlight.
- **Micro-Budget Friendly**: New slots start at only $1.00 USD.
- **Instant Live Update**: Verified payments immediately push the listing to the top of the leaderboard in real time without page refreshes.
- **Multi-Placement Gamification**: Sponsors and creators claiming multiple slots receive exclusive platform badges (`👑 Multi-Placement`).
- **Transparent Analytics**: Live visitor presence ticker and real-time bid statistics.
- **Fair Bidding Dynamics**: Clear rules, verified payments via Dodo Payments, and non-misleading link policies.

## Use Cases
- **Startup & Indie Hacker Launches**: Gaining instant eyeballs on day 1 for as low as $1.
- **SaaS Promotion**: Capturing tech enthusiast, investor, and early adopter attention.
- **Domain & Product Brokering**: Showcasing digital assets to active buyers.
- **Content Creators & Newsletters**: Driving targeted, real-time subscriber acquisition.
